question: Are the SDKs good? Are they easily usable?
answer: Good underneath, not yet easily usable. Average 5.3/10. Sixteen new packages (about 15-22 engineer-weeks) can start now and should bring each SDK to about 7.

topProblems.problem: Nobody can try Polaris Key without the hosted service.
topProblems.evidence: All 18 trials and both cross reviews built a backend from Worker test internals or hand-wrote 200-360-line stubs; two stubs invented a license_expired answer the Worker never sends; no integrator page covers a local run.

topProblems.problem: The first documented step or snippet fails in every SDK.
topProblems.evidence: 9 npm versions pin unpublished siblings (verified 2026-10-08); Python install resolves public PyPI; Kotlin quickstart 6 compile errors and 0.1.0 404; 5 Swift README snippets do not compile; React quickstart renders the error screen; Node kit factory points at production and the Electron snippet hangs; Godot boot snippet strands the player after Retry.

topProblems.problem: On Android, the documented Kotlin path cannot activate a licence.
topProblems.evidence: API 36 Ed25519 via AndroidKeyStore rejects RFC 8032 vectors; NetworkOnMainThreadException on split responses; unstarted client sends an empty device id; the artifact set fails AAR metadata; R8 fails.

Device token printed by print/repr/console.log (Node, Python, Swift); a typo in Python expected_services licenses an unactivated device; Python async is_licensed() truthy coroutine; Kotlin keeps revoked devices licensed and entitlementValue ungated; Node kit prints secrets and minted tokens; login silently swaps a paid key licence (Node kit, Swift).

topProblems.problem: The drop-in kits dead-end on states customers will hit.
topProblems.evidence: React sign-in shows no code, refusals lose the form; Swift expired/revoked only Retry; Godot Retry blank, offline activation without code; Kotlin keeps revoked licensed and hits 429; Node update apply dead end and login before discovery; Python verbs exit 2 and print tracebacks offline.

topProblems.problem: Expired, disabled and replaced devices read as a wrong key or 'Signed out', in all six.
topProblems.evidence: Worker answers 401 unauthorized for every unusable licence (authz.ts:381-382, activate-refusals.json:123); SDKs map sync 401 to revoked.

topProblems.problem: Building your own UI means re-deriving the state model.
topProblems.evidence: 110-410 lines of glue per own-UI trial; sync failure looks like success; licence events differ by SDK and entry point; copy unreachable outside the kits.

topProblems.problem: The docs and the console do not present the choice, and the docs describe a spec.
topProblems.evidence: Console snippet library-only with no docs link (Kotlin's crashes on Android); build/ui/index.mdx names five drop-ins that do not ship; no React, SwiftUI or Godot framework page; no own-UI page; /docs needs a platform-admin session.

topProblems.problem: The product is not the hero.
topProblems.evidence: No SDK client reads core.presentation; kits show the slug, 'Welcome to this app' or the Polaris mark; the hosted device-code page shows the Polaris logo and 'Product: tidewater'.

lastVerifiedAt in ms in five SDKs while documented as seconds; identity.current() returns the licence holder; network vs network-error and 5xx mapped to not_found; boot() enrols in Node only; Swift expiresAt is the document's expiry.
